Photosensitivity has also been reported. Vardenafil may prolong the QT interval and is best avoided in patients with relevant risk factors such as hypokalaemia, congenital QT prolongation, or the use of antiarrhythmics of class Ia or class III. Dos- age reductions may be required in patients with hepatic or renal impairment. Effects on the cardiovascular system. References. 1. Thadani U, et al.
